recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast cinematic portrait of a male protagonist in a varsity jacket, set against a deep black background. The composition features a large, aggressive, hand-painted red title at the top right and clean, gold-toned sans-serif typography at the top left and bottom edge.
coreVisualRelationships: The red title acts as a vibrant counterpoint to the dark, moody photography.
The protagonist's gaze and the vertical gun barrel create a strong central focal point.
The gold typography balances the composition by framing the top and bottom edges.
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space surrounding the subject.
Warm, directional lighting on the skin and jacket textures.
A stark contrast between the textured, rough title and the clean, geometric secondary text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Protagonist is centered-right, shown from the waist up, angled toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The protagonist's face and the metallic sheen of the handgun.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright red title, moves down to the face, follows the arm to the gun, and settles on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black void occupying approximately 60% of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (background and jacket body) providing depth and focus.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (title) and Gold (secondary text) for hierarchy.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject and background; high saturation only in the red title.

letterConstructionRules: Main title: Thick, aggressive brush strokes with jagged, dry-brush edges and a heavy rightward slant.
Secondary text: Uniform stroke weight, high-waisted, condensed geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Roman numerals integrated into the script flow with similar rough texture.
Extreme kerning in the secondary text to span the width of the layout.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, textured script paired with ultra-clean, widely spaced geometric sans-serif for a 'grit vs. glamour' aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines separating text elements

preserve: Dry-brush texture of the red title
avoid: Centered alignment for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, hand-painted feel of the primary title.
Captures the condensed, high-waisted geometry of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic low-key photo of a man in a black and cream varsity jacket holding a chrome handgun, looking over his shoulder with a smirk. Background is pure black. Lighting is warm and directional from the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, slanted, distressed red brush-script title in the top right. Add a gold, ultra-condensed, wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle in the top left and a matching credit line along the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the red title visibly textured with brush strokes?
Is the secondary text widely spaced and gold-toned?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red title texture
Tracking width of the gold text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the actor
Exact wording of the soundtrack credits
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red title does not obscure the face.
Check that the gold text is legible against the black.
Verify the varsity jacket has a distinct cream-on-black contrast.
Confirm the handgun has a realistic metallic sheen.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a moody, low-key character portrait with a high-energy, hand-painted title and ultra-clean, wide-tracked supporting typography for a classic action-genre aesthetic.
